input.subject: Weekend Sale at the Coffee Shop – This Saturday & Sunday Only!
input.body:
Hi there,

Great news for coffee lovers: our weekend sale is almost here!

This Saturday and Sunday, stop by for special offers on your favorite drinks, freshly baked treats, and select coffee beans and merchandise.

What to expect:
- Discounts on espresso drinks, brewed coffee, and seasonal specials
- Deals on pastries and baked goods
- Special pricing on bags of our house-roasted beans

Sale details:
- When: This Saturday and Sunday, during regular opening hours
- Where: Visit us in-store

Bring a friend, grab your favorite cup, and enjoy a little extra savings with us. Offers are available while supplies last.

We can't wait to see you!

Warm regards,
The Coffee Shop Team

P.S. Know someone who'd love a good deal on great coffee? Forward this email along!
